_comment: Keys FILE example - copy to spec/keys.json (gitignored), or point VERDICT_BENCH_KEYS_FILE at your own. The env var path is preferred; this file is the fallback when a key cannot be exported. Resolution order is this repo's own: --key-env / env_key -> alt_env_keys -> this file -> loud error. No key is ever written to a config, a results file, or a receipt row.

_usage.note: A provider absent here still resolves from its env var.
